segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Donald Trump wants to end birthright citizenship.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Left-wing media and Democrats are fighting it tooth and nail

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: because illegals, indeed criminals, are their mother's milk.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Among Donald Trump's first avalanche of executive orders

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: was one ending birthright citizenship,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: the policy where almost anybody born on U.S. soil

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: automatically gets citizenship.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: The practice itself comes from a misreading of the 14th Amendment,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: which granted citizenship to freed slaves,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: specifically to, quote,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: all persons born in the United States

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: and subject to the jurisdiction thereof.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: The key phrase here is subject to the jurisdiction.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: That's long been understood to exclude diplomats,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: so birth alone is not enough,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: but jurisdiction is actually a whole lot more limiting.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Historian Tom Wood cites the authors of the 14th Amendment,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: who said, quote,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: this will not, of course, include persons born in the United States

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: who are foreigners or aliens,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: because it only applies to people, quote,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: not owing allegiance to any foreign sovereignty.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: In other words, if you have citizenship of another country, say Mexico,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: you are not under the jurisdiction, according to the 14th.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Why?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Because the point of the 14th was to give citizenship to former slaves

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: who held no other citizenship.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Now, notably, for 50 years after the 14th,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Indians were not given birthright citizenship,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: specifically because they were citizens of another nation,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: the Navajo, Comanche, Seminole.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: And when they were given birthright citizenship,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: it was by act of Congress, not the 14th.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Of course, not only are legal subject to the jurisdiction of another country,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: they are in this country illegally.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: They are literally fugitives from the law,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: the very definition of not under the jurisdiction.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Now, this all matters because so-called birthright citizenship

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: is one of the most abused parts of our immigration system.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Every year, roughly 622,000 people are born to non-citizen parents,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: of which 400,000 to illegals.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: That comes to one in six births in the country.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: In the case of illegals, anchor babies become a jackpot.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: One study found 75% of migrants from Guatemala and Mexico with children

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: are on federal welfare programs,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: adding up to hundreds of billions in costs.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Indeed, we've heard stories from Biden's illegals

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: where young women in shelters try to get knocked up

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: by pretty much anybody to get that precious anchor baby,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: your tax dollars at work.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: The abuse extends to an estimated 40,000 so-called birth tourists

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: who literally fly to America on vacation,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: give birth, and go home with the status of parents of an American citizen

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: despite having spent mere days in the country.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: This is a full-on industry in China and Taiwan

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: where pre-birthing centers are common,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: kind of an assisted care for pregnant women.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: But instead of doing it in China,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: they fly to a center in LA,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: fully staffed by Chinese,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: and presto, they get all the benefits of citizenship.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: All in between the illegals, temporary visas like H-1Bs or students

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: and birth tourists,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: one in six new Americans either should not be here

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: or have almost no connection to the country.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: So it's next, brought to you by Unchain.com.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: The left will go to war on this because they know

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: the vast majority of beneficiaries will vote left.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: The case they'll keep citing is Wong Kim Ark from 1873,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: which grants citizenship to the child of permanent residence,

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: something most Americans are probably fine with

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: and something that has nothing to do

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: with these 622,000 illegals and tourists abusing the system.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Okay, we'll be watching.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: See you next time.
